backend/main.mo: Motoko actor providing user profiles, approval workflow, access control, and chat request storage with admin caching logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing features, related files, components, test IDs, and confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing multiple frontend files including screens, hooks, components, and Firebase utilities.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment runbook detailing pre-deploy checks, build steps, post-deploy approval gating verification, rollback steps, and troubleshooting.
frontend/firestore.rules: Firestore security rules defining permissions for users, admins, chat requests, and messages with role and approval checks.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, applying base border and body styles.
frontend/index.html: Loads Firebase SDKs, initializes Firebase app globally, and mounts the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/LIVE_SMOKE_TEST.md: End‑to‑end smoke test checklist verifying signup, approval gating, login flows, server reads, redirects, and error handling.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Implements client-side routing with React state, showing screens based on path and protecting routes with auth guards.
frontend/src/components/admin/UserRowAct: Provides admin dropdown actions for approving, rejecting, blocking, and promoting users with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/auth/AdminRouteG: Blocks access to children unless the user profile shows admin-level roles, showing a loader while checking.
frontend/src/components/auth/Authenticat: Ensures the user is authenticated and has a profile before rendering children, otherwise redirects via callback.
Defines a centered auth page layout with a footer and space for auth-related child components.
frontend/src/components/auth/SuperAdminR: Restricts access to super-admin users only, showing a permission check loader.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Renders the top header with app logo and user avatar menu, using user profile data.
frontend/src/components/layout/ProfileMe: Displays a dropdown menu with profile info, admin options, and logout handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor bound to the current identity, reinitializing and invalidating queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirebaseAuthUser.t: React hook that waits for Firebase CDN modules to load, sets up an auth state listener, and exposes the current user and loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirestorePendingUs: Provides a React Query hook to fetch pending users and perform approve, reject, block, or promote mutations with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirestoreUserProfi: Fetches the authenticated user's Firestore profile using React Query, refreshing data whenever the auth user changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirestoreUsersList: Retrieves the full users list and exposes mutations for updating approval and role with automatic query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity auth context using DFINITY AuthClient, handling login, logout, identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables for light and dark modes and applying global base styles.
frontend/src/lib/firebase.ts: Wrapper around CDN-loaded Firebase providing dynamic module loading and helper functions for user profile operations and Firestore queries.
frontend/src/lib/firebaseErrorMessages.t: Maps Firebase auth and Firestore error codes to user-friendly error messages.
frontend/src/lib/firebaseTypes.ts: Type definitions for Firestore user profiles and signup data.
frontend/src/lib/postLoginRedirect.ts: Computes the post-login redirect route based on role and approval status.
Client-side utility to resize, compress, validate, and return metadata for uploaded profile images.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility function combining clsx and tailwind-merge for className merging.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point configuring React Query, Internet Identity provider, and rendering the root app.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminChatsScr: Admin-protected screen showing a placeholder for future chat management features.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminDashboar: Admin dashboard summarizing user statistics with protected access and loading states.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminLayout.t: Shared admin layout providing navigation, sidebar, mobile menu, and content wrapper.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminReportsS: Admin-protected page displaying a placeholder for future reporting and analytics.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminSettings: Admin settings screen showing a placeholder for upcoming configuration features.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminUsersScr: Admin interface for listing, reviewing, and approving pending users with role-based visibility.
frontend/src/screens/ChatScreen.tsx: Implements a full chat interface with chat list, message fetching, sending, and UI for empty or loading states using React Query and Firebase.
frontend/src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx: Displays a personalized welcome page with basic onboarding cards and a footer.
frontend/src/screens/LoginScreen.tsx: Handles email/password login, error handling, profile checks, and redirects based on user role and status.
frontend/src/screens/PasswordResetScreen: Provides a UI-only password reset request flow that notifies the user their request will be handled manually by an admin.
frontend/src/screens/PendingApprovalScre: Shows a pending-approval message explaining next steps and offering a return-to-login option.
frontend/src/screens/ProfileScreen.tsx: Displays user profile details, avatar, role badges, and loading/empty states using Firestore data.
frontend/src/screens/SignupScreen.tsx: Signup form handling user info, profile photo capture/processing, validation, and Firebase signup.
frontend/src/screens/users/ApprovedUsers: Displays approved users, incoming and outgoing chat requests, and handles sending or responding to chat requests via Firebase.
frontend/src/screens/users/UserManagemen: Admin view listing all users and allowing approval status updates using Firebase mutations.
frontend/src/screens/UsersScreen.tsx: Loads current user profile and displays the unified approved users list view.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading URL params, persisting them in sessionStorage, and manipulating hash-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing current production issues, requirements, and feature constraints related to user profile rendering.
